source_caption_text:
My playlist everyday

Nardwuar asking rappers “Who are you?” has given us some pretty memorable moments over the years. From Drake introducing himself as Aubrey Drake Graham to Travis Scott keeping it simple with “I’m Travis. Travis Scott,” everyone has their own way of answering the legendary question.

Via @nardwuar

A$AP Rocky went with his usual confidence, while 21 Savage gave one of the funniest answers by saying, “Savage, Kendrick Lamar.” Future, Young Thug and Gunna each brought their own personalities to their interviews, making every interaction feel a little different.

That’s part of what makes Nardwuar’s interviews so entertaining. Even with the same opening question, you never know what kind of response you’re going to get from some of the biggest names in rap.
